title: Red heifer ordinance — the five steps, ending with immersing in a mikvah
summary: Under the heading that the red heifer ordinance is the most mysterious of the chukat (statutes), the slide lists all five steps: find an unblemished heifer never used as a beast of burden; slaughter and burn it outside the city with cedar wood, hyssop and crimson wool; mix its ashes with spring water; cleanse with that water on the 3rd and 7th day after defilement; and immerse in a mikvah.

text.text: The Ordinance of the Red Heifer
is the most mysterious of the
1. Find a red heifer that is completely unblemished and never used as a beast of burden.
2. Slaughter it and burn it together outside the city with some cedar wood, some hyssop, and some crimson wool.
3. Mix its ashes with spring water.
4. Cleanse yourself with that water on the 3rd and 7th day after defilement.
